task: D6.1 read-only manager API compatibility boundary, dataSource DTO marker, and candidate-page shadow comparison
decision: The first M9 slice is implemented and verified: Flask can proxy selected manager read routes through a bounded HTTP client, DEX DTOs expose dataSource=legacy|manager, and the candidate page supports an opt-in read-only manager shadow with bounded row-level comparison. Existing page URLs, templates, layouts, and business projections remain unchanged. No page has been switched to manager business data yet.

implementation.dataSourcePolicy: MANAGER_UI_DATA_SOURCE defaults to legacy. In legacy mode the manager proxy returns HTTP 409 and performs no outbound request. In manager mode successful responses set dataSource=manager. Existing DEX DTOs set dataSource=legacy unless they already carry a domain-specific dataSource object.
implementation.managerApiBaseUrlPolicy: MANAGER_API_BASE_URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8091. Only absolute http/https URLs without embedded credentials are accepted.
implementation.timeoutPolicy: MANAGER_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS defaults to 3 and must be between 0.1 and 30.

architecturePolicy.errorDtoCompatibility: Compatibility errors retain the standard error object and also expose top-level code/detail for existing page clients.

fixtures: manager proxy routes are disabled and make no outbound request by default
manager mode maps Flask route arguments to manager GET paths
manager transport errors return structured HTTP 503 with dataSource=manager
limit bounds are validated before calling manager_api
run id path segments are URL-encoded
invalid manager base URLs, timeouts, UI source values, and non-object JSON responses fail closed
legacy DEX DTOs receive dataSource=legacy without overwriting an existing domain-specific dataSource object
manager routes are included in scope and response schema registries
candidate manager shadow is disabled without network access while MANAGER_UI_DATA_SOURCE=legacy
candidate manager shadow exposes version/checksum/status counts and keeps legacy page fields unchanged
candidate manager row-array counts are labeled with the 1000-row snapshot limit rather than treated as full materialization counts
candidate manager shadow requests sampleLimit=200 row comparison for anchors, pairs, pools, and recommendations
candidate manager row comparison remains diagnostic when the compare endpoint fails and does not affect the legacy page payload
candidate page attaches managerShadow only when manager_compare=true
knownBoundary: M9 page-level migration is not complete. The candidate page exposes an opt-in manager shadow with bounded row-level diagnostics, but its rendered business fields and dataSource remain legacy. Market-observation, closed-loop, review, submission/broadcast, and overview page DTOs still use legacy Python data paths. The compatibility layer is read-only and does not authorize production authority cutover. The next slice is an unbounded dual-read on a production copy followed by one controlled manager-backed read path while preserving existing URLs and visual structure.
